title: Krita TIF File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-134043)
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Krita's TIF file parsing functionality. This flaw allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by convincing a user to open a malicious TIF file or visit a malicious page. Exploitation requires user interaction. The vulnerability arises from improper validation of user-supplied data length before copying it to a heap buffer.
